iron_lung.name: Iron Lung
iron_lung.description: @icon(health_cost)s, including @icon(empower)'s, are paid from your @icon(stoneskin) first, at 2 @icon(stoneskin) per @icon(health).

pilgrim_boots.name: Pilgrim Boots
pilgrim_boots.description: Gain @icon(move) +{0.value} each turn. Your movement creates @icon(illuminate) {1.radius} @icon(time) {1.duration} along its path; @icon(blink) covers both endpoints.

mirror_shard.name: Mirror Shard
mirror_shard.description: When one of your @icon(illusion)s is destroyed, it shatters, dealing 3 damage to each enemy next to it.

coffin_nails.name: Coffin Nails
coffin_nails.description: When your @icon(block) stops all of an enemy attack's damage, the attacker @icon(bleed)s 1.

iron_buckler.name: Iron Buckler
iron_buckler.description: At the start of your turn, keep up to 3 of your @icon(block).

flint_edge.name: Flint Edge
flint_edge.description: Your @icon(melee) attacks consume the @icon(surface_fire), @icon(surface_ice) or @icon(surface_electrified) under their target to deal 3 more damage.

static_soles.name: Static Soles
static_soles.description: Your first @icon(move) or @icon(blink) each turn leaves @icon(surface_electrified) at its origin and grants @icon(vision) 1 for 2 turns.

mossbound_wraps.name: Mossbound Wraps
mossbound_wraps.description: The first Earth card you play while you have @icon(block) each turn grants @icon(stoneskin) {0.reward0.amount}.

tailwind_fletching.name: Tailwind Fletching
tailwind_fletching.description: Air @icon(push) and @icon(pull) actions deal +{0.amount} damage and force enemies {1.amount} farther.

frost_prism.name: Shatterglass Prism
frost_prism.description: Enemies you kill with attacks while @icon(freeze) leave @icon(surface_rubble) beneath and beside them.

gale_tabi.name: Gale Tabi
gale_tabi.description: After you @icon(blink), your next attack this turn deals 1 more damage for each tile you @icon(blink)ed (max 4 more).

anchor_chain.name: Anchor Chain
anchor_chain.description: While you have @icon(block), @icon(push) and @icon(pull) deal +{0.amount} damage and send targets {1.amount} tile farther.

venom_signet.name: Quarry Signet
venom_signet.description: Enemies standing on @icon(surface_rubble) take 1 more damage from everything: attacks, @icon(collision)s, @icon(surface_fire) and @icon(retaliate).

thawing_charm.name: Thawing Charm
thawing_charm.description: Excess @icon(heal) becomes @icon(stoneskin), up to {cap} each turn. The first conversion each turn creates @icon(illuminate) 1 @icon(time) 2 at you.

ember_siphon.name: Ember Siphon
ember_siphon.description: When an enemy dies while standing on @icon(surface_fire), @icon(surface_fire) spreads to each empty tile next to where it fell.

bloodglass_knife.name: Bloodglass Knife
bloodglass_knife.description: While at @icon(health) 50% or less with no @icon(block) or @icon(stoneskin), your attacks deal +{value} damage.

cold_mirror.name: Cold Mirror
cold_mirror.description: When you @icon(freeze) an enemy while you have 4 or more @icon(block), your @icon(block) hardens: lose all your @icon(block) and gain 1 @icon(frost_armor) layer for every 4 lost (max 2).

thunder_relay.name: Thunder Relay
thunder_relay.description: Your @icon(chain) attacks can swap their first and last enemy targets if both survive.

thornmail_brooch.name: Faultline Brooch
thornmail_brooch.description: You may spend @icon(stoneskin) {cost} to turn a single-target @icon(melee) into a cross that leaves @icon(surface_rubble).

vaulting_sigil.name: Vaulting Sigil
vaulting_sigil.description: Your @icon(move) can pass through enemies (you can't stop on one). Each enemy you pass through is @icon(stagger)ed 2.

obsidian_heart.name: Obsidian Heart
obsidian_heart.description: Opening @icon(draw) {0.value}. At turn end, convert all remaining @icon(block) into @icon(stoneskin).

storm_crown.name: Storm Crown
storm_crown.description: Your @icon(chain) attacks rebound: after the last hop, the bolt travels back along its route, hitting each enemy again for half damage (rounded down).

phoenix_ember.name: Phoenix Ember
phoenix_ember.description: Gain @icon(defiance) {0.value} this run. When it triggers, @icon(dispel_umbra) {1.reward0.amount}, place @icon(surface_fire) beneath all enemies, @icon(draw) {1.reward2.amount}, and @icon(card_play) {1.reward3.amount}.

worldroot_idol.name: Worldroot Idol
worldroot_idol.description: While on @icon(surface_rubble), you may launch a single-target @icon(melee) or @icon(ranged) attack from another connected @icon(surface_rubble) tile, consuming it. The origin is chosen automatically.

cinderbrand_tongs.name: Cinderbrand Tongs
cinderbrand_tongs.description: Your first card each turn to create new @icon(surface_fire) also creates @icon(illuminate) 1 @icon(time) 2 at its target.

rimecatcher_vial.name: Rimecatcher Vial
rimecatcher_vial.description: When your attack applies @icon(freeze), you may @icon(surface_relocate) one consumed @icon(surface_ice) tile beside the target.

ion_spool.name: Ion Spool
ion_spool.description: The first @icon(element_lightning) attack each turn to conduct through {threshold}+ surface tiles grants @icon(draw) {0.reward0.amount}.

updraft_bottle.name: Updraft Bottle
updraft_bottle.description: Your @icon(push) and @icon(pull) can carry the elemental surface beneath the target to its destination.

basalt_calendar.name: Basalt Kiln
basalt_calendar.description: Your @icon(detonate) can consume @icon(surface_rubble) instead of @icon(surface_fire), leaving @icon(surface_fire) on the consumed tiles.

coalheart_crucible.name: Stormcoal Crucible
coalheart_crucible.description: @icon(surface_fire) tiles also conduct @icon(element_lightning). Attacks conducted through them consume them.

voltaic_tuning_fork.name: Stormglass Beacon
voltaic_tuning_fork.description: The first @icon(chain) attack each turn creates @icon(illuminate) {radius} @icon(time) {duration} beneath every enemy it hits.

tectonic_abacus.name: Captured Noon
tectonic_abacus.description: While you have 3 active @icon(illuminate) sources, lower @icon(umbra) by 1 stage; with 6 sources, lower it by 2.

overflow_censer.name: Overflow Censer
overflow_censer.description: When you place a @icon(surface) on a tile that holds a different elemental @icon(surface), the new @icon(surface) also spreads to each empty tile next to it.

black_sun_dial.name: Black Sun Dial
black_sun_dial.description: Consuming a @icon(surface) stores it (max 3). Your next attack deals 2 more damage per stored @icon(surface), and its target gets each one's effect: @icon(surface_fire) beneath it, @icon(chilled), @icon(shock), @icon(stagger) 2.

duelist_whetstone.name: Duelist Whetstone
duelist_whetstone.description: Attacks on cards that also @icon(move) or @icon(blink) deal 1 more damage for each tile you've @icon(move)d this turn (max 3 more).

hollow_die.name: Open-Eyed Pin
hollow_die.description: When a card grants @icon(vision) or @icon(truesight), create @icon(illuminate) {0.reward0.radius} at you matching that effect's @icon(time).

chorus_mask.name: Chorus Mask
chorus_mask.description: A card whose element differs from the last card you played this turn deals 2 more damage and grants 2 more @icon(block).

hourglass_splinter.name: Hourglass Splinter
hourglass_splinter.description: When you play a card that costs 6 or more @icon(time), @icon(quicken) 2.

funeral_bell.name: Funeral Bell
funeral_bell.description: When an enemy dies with 2 or more different statuses, such as @icon(bleed) and @icon(expose), each enemy next to it gains them.

bloodmoon_chalice.name: Bloodmoon Chalice
bloodmoon_chalice.description: When you lose @icon(health) during your turn, your next attack this turn deals 2 more damage per @icon(health) lost (max 8 more).

moonless_compass.name: Moonless Compass
moonless_compass.description: Once per combat, play separate @icon(move)/@icon(blink) and @icon(illuminate)/@icon(vision)/@icon(truesight) cards in one turn to gain @icon(stoneskin) {0.reward0.amount} and @icon(card_play) {0.reward1.amount}.

fivefold_knot.name: Fivefold Knot
fivefold_knot.description: Each element you play ties its knot for this combat. With 3 of the 5 knots, your attacks @icon(pierce); with 4, they also gain @icon(chain) 1; with all 5, every card you play also grants 3 @icon(block).

borrowed_hourglass.name: Borrowed Hourglass
borrowed_hourglass.description: Once per combat, when you end your turn with a @icon(card_play) unused, take another turn at once. Everything it costs is added to your next turn's @icon(time).

dawnbrand_filament.name: Dawnbrand Filament
dawnbrand_filament.description: The first direct attack each turn creates @icon(illuminate) {radius} @icon(time) {duration} at its target.

briar_winch.name: Quarry Winch
briar_winch.description: Consume @icon(surface_rubble) beneath a target to aim @icon(push) or @icon(pull) in any cardinal direction.

hourglass_awl.name: Hourglass Awl
hourglass_awl.description: Attacks on cards that cost 6 or more @icon(time) gain @icon(pierce).

beaconrunner_spurs.name: Beaconrunner Spurs
beaconrunner_spurs.description: Each tile of your @icon(illuminate) you enter during a @icon(move) refunds 1 movement (max 2 each turn).

dawnstitch_cord.name: Dawnstitch Cord
dawnstitch_cord.description: The first card each turn that creates @icon(illuminate), grants @icon(vision) or @icon(truesight), or uses @icon(dispel_umbra) grants @icon(block) {0.reward0.amount}.

starless_astrolabe.name: Starless Astrolabe
starless_astrolabe.description: While you have @icon(truesight), applying @icon(freeze) or @icon(shock) creates @icon(illuminate) {radius} @icon(time) {duration} beneath that enemy.

witchglass_carapace.name: Witchglass Carapace
witchglass_carapace.description: Enemy @icon(ranged) attacks deal at most {max_damage} damage to @icon(illusion).

witchglass_lantern.name: Witchglass Lantern
witchglass_lantern.description: Your @icon(illusion) have +{radius} @icon(illuminate) radius while they last.

sunlit_edge.name: Sunlit Edge
sunlit_edge.description: While you stand in @icon(illuminate), your attacks gain @icon(pierce).

glassway_compass.name: Glassway Compass
glassway_compass.description: Your @icon(move) and @icon(blink) can end on one of your @icon(illusion)s: you trade places with it.

unclouded_sun.name: Unclouded Sun
unclouded_sun.description: Your @icon(illuminate) is a road: when you @icon(move), every tile of your @icon(illuminate) counts as next to every other tile of your @icon(illuminate).

ashen_brand.name: Ashen Brand
ashen_brand.description: @icon(detonate) consumes the entire connected @icon(surface_fire) cluster. Each extra overlapping blast cross adds 25% base damage.

winters_spur.name: Winter’s Spur
winters_spur.description: Each straight stretch of @icon(surface_ice) costs 1 base @icon(move) per movement action. Turns start a new stretch.

resonant_clapper.name: Resonant Clapper
resonant_clapper.description: @icon(chain) gains 25% base damage per successive enemy hop. Empty relays and conduction-only hits neither advance nor receive this bonus.

galehook_talon.name: Galehook Talon
galehook_talon.description: @icon(push) and @icon(pull) displace a contiguous line of enemies together along the force axis. The group stops at an obstruction.

cragbound_gauntlet.name: Cragbound Gauntlet
cragbound_gauntlet.description: @icon(ranged) Earth spells raise a 3 @icon(health) outcrop at an empty ground target.

crowncoal_heart.name: Crowncoal Heart
crowncoal_heart.description: Each turn, your first single-target hit on ground without an elemental surface adds @icon(surface_fire). Your first @icon(detonate) consuming 2+ @icon(surface_fire) grants @icon(stoneskin) 6 after the blast.

worldheart.name: Worldheart
worldheart.description: At turn end, convert up to 2 remaining @icon(block) into @icon(stoneskin). Whenever you gain @icon(stoneskin), deal half that amount, rounded down, to adjacent enemies (maximum 4).

unbound_pinion.name: Unbound Pinion
unbound_pinion.description: The first card action each turn that @icon(move)s an enemy 2 or more tiles, or makes it collide, refills your movement and @icon(draw)s 1.

winters_hour.name: Winter's Hourglass
winters_hour.description: Your first @icon(element_ice) card each turn stores @icon(time) 3 (maximum 3). Non-@icon(element_ice) cards spend stored @icon(time) to reduce their cost, to a minimum of @icon(time) 1. Stored @icon(time) lasts this combat.

stormroad_coil.name: Stormroad Coil
stormroad_coil.description: Single-target @icon(ranged) attacks can relay once through @icon(surface_electrified), with normal @icon(range) on each leg.

eclipse_mantle.name: Eclipse Mantle
eclipse_mantle.description: Your first @icon(blink) each turn leaves @icon(illusion) 2 at its origin. Your @icon(illusion) radiate @icon(illuminate) 2 while they last.

recoil_plates.name: Recoil Plates
recoil_plates.description: You take 1 damage per lost tile from @icon(collision)s instead of 2. Whenever you are part of a @icon(collision), gain 3 @icon(block).

millstone_fob.name: Millstone Fob
millstone_fob.description: When an enemy you @icon(push) or @icon(pull) collides, the tile it stopped on becomes @icon(surface_rubble).

tallow_candle.name: Tallow Candle
tallow_candle.description: At the start of each combat, create radius-2 @icon(illuminate) on your tile for 3 turns.

pocket_sundial.name: Pocket Sundial
pocket_sundial.description: Each @icon(card_play) you leave unused at the end of your turn makes your next turn come 1 @icon(time) sooner (max 2).

leaden_pommel.name: Leaden Pommel
leaden_pommel.description: Attacks on cards that cost 5 or more @icon(time) @icon(stagger) 1.

pitch_gloves.name: Pitch Gloves
pitch_gloves.description: @icon(surface_fire) deals you 1 less damage. @icon(surface_fire) you create deals enemies 1 more.

hobnail_cleats.name: Hobnail Cleats
hobnail_cleats.description: @icon(surface_ice) doesn't make you @icon(chilled). While you stand on @icon(surface_ice), your @icon(element_ice) attacks deal 2 more damage.

grounding_pin.name: Grounding Pin
grounding_pin.description: Your single-target attacks against an enemy standing on @icon(surface_electrified) gain @icon(chain) 1.

rubblewalker_greaves.name: Rubblewalker Greaves
rubblewalker_greaves.description: @icon(surface_rubble) doesn't slow you. Start each turn standing on @icon(surface_rubble) with 1 @icon(stoneskin).

waxen_effigy.name: Waxen Effigy
waxen_effigy.description: At the start of each combat, create a 2-@icon(health) @icon(illusion) on the empty tile next to you nearest an enemy.

quick_draw_bandolier.name: Quick-Draw Bandolier
quick_draw_bandolier.description: Your items don't use a @icon(card_play), but cost 1 more @icon(time).

briar_vambrace.name: Briar Vambrace
briar_vambrace.description: When a card gives you @icon(block), also gain @icon(retaliate) 1 until your next turn.

fencers_gloves.name: Fencer's Gloves
fencers_gloves.description: Your second card each turn costs 1 less @icon(time).

feint_ribbon.name: Feint Ribbon
feint_ribbon.description: If you've @icon(move)d 2 or more tiles this turn, your first card counts as a @icon(follow_up).

battering_yoke.name: Battering Yoke
battering_yoke.description: When an enemy you @icon(push) or @icon(pull) collides with another enemy, that enemy is knocked 1 tile in the same direction, colliding normally if it can't @icon(move).

pendulum_weight.name: Pendulum Weight
pendulum_weight.description: @icon(stagger) beyond an enemy's per-turn limit is dealt to it as damage instead.

martyrs_gorget.name: Martyr's Gorget
martyrs_gorget.description: When your @icon(retaliate) damages an attacker, gain that much @icon(block).

reliquary_box.name: Reliquary Box
reliquary_box.description: Your opening hand includes a @icon(rite) from your deck, if you have one. @icon(rite)s cost 1 less @icon(time).

changelings_rattle.name: Changeling's Rattle
changelings_rattle.description: When an enemy destroys one of your @icon(illusion)s, it is @icon(stagger)ed 3 and @icon(expose)d 2.

copper_shod_staff.name: Copper-Shod Staff
copper_shod_staff.description: Your outcrops and @icon(illusion)s count as @icon(surface_electrified) for your @icon(element_lightning): they conduct and carry @icon(chain), and take no damage from it.

ashen_phylactery.name: Ashen Phylactery
ashen_phylactery.description: When a card @icon(exhaust)s, gain @icon(stoneskin) equal to the @icon(time) you paid for it (max 5).

bonded_set.name: Bonded Set
bonded_set.description: Cards from an equipment piece that shares its element with another equipped piece deal 1 more damage and grant 1 more @icon(block).

masons_plumb.name: Mason's Plumb
masons_plumb.description: Your outcrops have 2 more @icon(health). An enemy that collides with one of your outcrops takes 2 more damage, and the outcrop takes none.

breaking_wheel.name: The Breaking Wheel
breaking_wheel.description: An enemy that collides on a @icon(surface) breaks it: @icon(surface_fire) deals 3 more damage, @icon(surface_ice) @icon(freeze)s it, @icon(surface_electrified) @icon(shock)s it and its blocker, @icon(surface_rubble) @icon(stagger)s it 3.

hollow_puppet.name: Hollow Puppet
hollow_puppet.description: Your @icon(push) and @icon(pull) can target your @icon(illusion)s without damaging them. An @icon(illusion) that collides with an enemy shatters, dealing its remaining @icon(health) to that enemy instead of @icon(collision) damage.

toll_late_bell.name: Toll of the Late Bell
toll_late_bell.description: Enemies set to act after your next turn on the @icon(turn_clock) are late: your attacks deal them 3 more damage.

rosary_of_vows.name: Rosary of Vows
rosary_of_vows.description: At the start of your turn, gain 2 @icon(block) for each of your active @icon(rite)s.

siege_ram_totem.name: Siege Ram Totem
siege_ram_totem.description: Any enemy that takes @icon(collision) damage is @icon(stagger)ed by that much (within the normal limit).

echoing_blade.name: Echoing Blade
echoing_blade.description: When a @icon(follow_up) bonus applies, your next card this turn costs 1 less @icon(time) and deals 2 more damage.

alchemists_retort.name: Alchemist's Retort
alchemists_retort.description: Your items' damage, @icon(block), @icon(heal)ing and @icon(stoneskin) are increased by half, rounded up.

crown_of_surplus.name: Crown of Surplus
crown_of_surplus.description: Cards without their own @icon(empower) gain one: @icon(empower) (+3 @icon(time)): repeat the card's first action. @icon(rite)s, items and @icon(flurry) cards are excluded.

mirror_triptych.name: Mirror Triptych
mirror_triptych.description: Your first attack card each turn is echoed by up to three of your @icon(illusion)s: each repeats its first attack from its own tile against the nearest enemy it can reach, at half damage (rounded down), then loses 1 @icon(health).

pyre_keepers_urn.name: Pyre-Keeper's Urn
pyre_keepers_urn.description: At the start of your turn, the card you most recently @icon(exhaust)ed returns to your hand, unless it is a @icon(rite) or @icon(heal)s.

briar_throne.name: Briar Throne
briar_throne.description: Your @icon(retaliate) no longer expires, and grows by 1 each time it triggers. Cards can't give you @icon(block).

whirling_sash.name: Whirling Sash
whirling_sash.description: Gain 1 extra @icon(card_play) each turn. Each card after your second each turn costs 2 more @icon(time).

quartermasters_ledger.name: Quartermaster's Ledger
quartermasters_ledger.description: Your items are no longer @icon(consume)d, except @icon(heal)ing items. Each item can be used once per combat.
